lead_raw_text:
The structure of PrMg2Hf crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Pr3Mg6Hf3) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: each Hf and Pr center has 12 geometric neighbors (6 Mg, 3 Hf/Pr, and 3 Mg, 6 Hf/Pr, respectively, with distances of 3.16–3.49 Å), while each Mg center has 12 neighbors (3 Hf, 6 Mg, 3 Pr). The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, plus edge- and face-sharing between Hf- and Pr-centered polyhedra.
